title: The story of Tsutomu Yamaguchi, the only survivor of both Hiroshima and Nagasaki atomic bombings
summary_full: Tsutomu Yamaguchi's remarkable story is one of survival against unimaginable odds, as he endured the horrors of two atomic bombings just days apart in August 1945. Initially in Hiroshima on August 6, he found himself in Nagasaki on August 9. Post-war, Yamaguchi channeled his experiences into activism, passionately advocating for nuclear disarmament at the United Nations, illustrating the catastrophic effects of nuclear armament.
